key_points: Cisco reported 18% revenue growth and $9.3B AI-related orders, beating expectations.
Stock surged 46% YTD 2026 on AI infrastructure demand and strong earnings.
Wall Street Zen upgraded rating; Bank of America turned bullish ahead of earnings.
New board member with three decades of tech leadership added; several institutions increased holdings.
Despite the beat, shares dipped 9% on profit‑taking and questions about flat services growth.
